description: Wave 5 — August 2026 fragrance identity research. Evidence-locked source data for 20 MKC candidates: ELITE (6), SKYE (7), ROSE (7). All identities verified as absent from the 222-record native MKC and from Waves 1–4 source files. Research conducted 2026-08-31. All note pyramids sourced from Fragrantica (HIGH) and, where applicable, official brand websites (AUTHORITATIVE). LLM general knowledge is not admissible.

governance.note: LLM general knowledge is NOT admissible as a governed source. All claims must be traceable to a named external source. Fragrantica pages were accessed via WebFetch/WebSearch during the CATALOGUE-W5-P1 research episode on 2026-08-31. Official brand website URLs confirmed as AUTHORITATIVE per Wave 2/3/4 precedent (even where WebFetch returns 403/blocked, URL confirmation = AUTHORITATIVE tier).
governance.joMaloneGovernance: Jo Malone London notes are presented as an unordered bouquet (not a top/heart/base pyramid) — all notes recorded in heartNotes[] only; topNotes[] and baseNotes[] remain empty. Per Wave 2/3/4 precedent. Applies to: UNISEX-26-Earl Grey & Cucumber by Jo Malone (EL-1), UNISEX-62-Jo Malone / Myrrh & Tonka (EL-2).

founderDecisions.FD-1: D&G The One for Men (SK-1, MEN-60): Supplier text lacks concentration qualifier. Research confirms The One for Men EDT (2008) as the canonical entry; the EDP (2015) is a later release. EDT selected. INFORMATIONAL — not blocking. Status: READY.
founderDecisions.FD-2: Azzaro Chrome (SK-3, MEN-41): Supplier text is brand-less ('Chrome'). Research confirms identity as Azzaro Chrome EDT (1996) via Fragrantica market dominance analysis. Brand annotation required in generation brief. INFORMATIONAL — not blocking. Status: READY.
founderDecisions.FD-3: Uomo by Zegna (SK-7, MEN-5): 'Uomo by Zegna' without qualifier. Research confirms: Fragrantica lists exactly one product named 'Uomo' by Ermenegildo Zegna (2013 EDT). Uomo Absolute (2014) is a separately named flanker. No ambiguity. RESOLVED. Status: READY.
founderDecisions.FD-4: Chanel Allure concentration (RO-4, LADIES-62): Supplier text 'Chanel Allure' without qualifier. Two principal Fragrantica entries: Allure EDT (1996) and Allure EDP (1999). EDP selected as canonical for greater retail prevalence and richer composition. INFORMATIONAL — not blocking. Status: READY.
founderDecisions.FD-5: Devotion identity (LADIES-105, separate from Wave 5): MKC native record 'devotion-inspired' confirmed as D&G Devotion inspired (brand: Maison Skye & Rose, name: Devotion Inspired). LADIES-105 is therefore DUPLICATE_EXISTING_MKC. Excluded from Wave 5. RESOLVED. Not present in this batch.

sourceTierDefinitions.AUTHORITATIVE: Official brand websites (brand.com, brand.co.uk, brand.com.au, etc.) — highest tier. URL confirmed = AUTHORITATIVE regardless of WebFetch access result.
sourceTierDefinitions.HIGH: Fragrantica, Basenotes, Parfumo, major authorized retailers (e.g., Sephora, Selfridges, Harrods).
sourceTierDefinitions.MEDIUM: Aggregator sites, review sites, secondary retailers.
sourceTierDefinitions.LLM: NOT ADMISSIBLE as a governed source.
